headline: Callahan's Passage Cleared of Colonial Posts; Nevish Line Pressed Hard
war_summary: Callahan's Passage, which stood nine Warden posts to one Colonial at the last filing, is now Warden throughout save a single unclaimed position, five events falling in the past two hours at Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage while casualties run near 477 Colonial and 690 Warden the hour. Nevish Line has shifted further Warden, six posts against two Colonial where four and three stood before; twenty-five events have been logged in the day, the latest at Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way. Stlican Shelf has gone the other way by one post, six Colonial to two Warden with one unclaimed, Breaker Town the busiest ground. Palantine Berm's exchanges have eased to two events in the last two hours after thirty-one across the day, though the Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni remain scenes of heavy mutual loss. Weathered Expanse, the day's leader at thirty events, has calmed since the morning, its posts two Warden and seven Colonial. Kuura Strand, where casualties passed a thousand on each side during the past day, has fallen silent. Mooring County holds eleven posts to one Colonial and Gutter remains entirely Warden. No victor has been declared.
